news.title: Making harvest more efficient with geographic information science
news.summary_en: University of Northern Iowa senior Kyler Frerichs' hands-on internship with a local farm group has led to a full-time geographic information science job upon graduation.

news.title: UNI President Mark Nook to retire at conclusion of current academic year
news.summary_en: Mark Nook will continue to serve until the 12th president of the University of Northern Iowa begins their service.
